rationale: The agent performed multiple order-changing actions (two cancellations and two returns) without any explicit user confirmation shown, violating the policy to confirm before writes. The user wanted to cancel the charger, boot, and kettle and return the sneaker; the actions taken do not clearly match those requests (two cancellations only, plus two returns—likely exceeding the single requested return). There is no clear evidence the tracking number for the tablet was provided, nor that the agent addressed the lost-tablet refund/reorder with appropriate guidance or escalation/hand-off. While a lookup by name and ZIP was done, other critical policy requirements (confirmation and clear, correct final information) were not met. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
